title: The Vexis
description: After finding the dagger. Rey and company move to escape the tunnels. Further in, they face to face with the Vexis, the magnificent snake-like creature that crafted the tunnels that they just explored. The Vexis rears back, preparing to attack when Rey, sensing pain in the creature, inches closer. Closer inspection reveals a wound on the serpent. Rey holds her hand out and heals the cut with the Force. In return, the Vexis opens an escape path, allowing the group to leave.
